input_file.description: The source FLV file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

output_file.description: The resulting FLV file. Use '-' to write to stdout.

xml_output_file.description: An XML file with the resulting metadata information. If omitted, only FLV output or stdin/stdout is used.

temporary_file.description: A temporary file to store the source FLV file in if the input file is read from stdin.

creator.description: A string that will be written into the creator tag.

audio_interval.description: Time in milliseconds between keyframes if there is only audio. 0 or empty means no keyframes added if omitted.

strip_metadata.description: Strip all metadata from the FLV. Ignores -s and -k.

omit_keyframes_xml.description: Omit the keyframes tag in the XML output.

replace_input.description: Replace the input file with the output file. -i and -o are required to be different files.

custom_flags.description: Additional command-line flags to append. Valid values: -s, -k, -M, -X, -w, -h, -l.
